sentence: MedlinePlus lists tadalafil among medicines called phosphodiesterase inhibitors.
StatPearls says PDE5 inhibitors act on the enzyme in the smooth muscle of blood vessels and stop it breaking down cGMP.
A review adds that this builds up cGMP, relaxes smooth muscle and increases blood flow.
The same review says the drugs resemble cGMP in structure and boost the effects of nitric oxide.

sentence: The NHS says tadalafil may not be suitable for everyone.
This includes people who have had an allergic reaction or serious side effect from it before, or who have recently had a heart attack or stroke.
It also includes people with low blood pressure or uncontrolled high blood pressure, and people with liver or kidney problems.
Certain blood cancers and sickle cell anaemia are also listed.
So are past vision loss in one eye from reduced blood flow to the optic nerve, and a curved or bent penis that makes erections painful or difficult.
